about_the_game:
The Game

Knowmad is a game where your decisions shapes the world. It has a unique twist of casual strategy and rougelite game and slowly unfolds as you make each decision. The story revolves our hero with limited time on earth and has to find what his purpose is. The game starts slow and won't be obvious what to do, you have to figure it out with only what you see on the screen. Be ready to meet friends and foe along the way.

Your decisions shape the world you live in

Choices comes as you travel around the world and overcome various challenges and monsters. As you defeat each one of them, you are rewarded with a power up, each with their own pros and cons.

Decisions Decisions

Test decisions you made in battle!

Decisions you made to power up your hero will ultimately determine whether he can beat the challenges/monsters in front of him or not.

This game will challenge even seasoned deckbuilder players, finding the right balance and only certain situations

The Art

Everything in the game is carefully hand drawn the team and created by the team. From the music, the sound effects, to the cards, to the levels, the code, and everything in between is built from scratch by us! (yes even the sound effects!)
